textos.linha_en: What nature decides: **β_TGL was read in nature above 5σ in one channel, the Hubble ratio (H0DN × BG1, 12 Nov 2026), under the published error model**: 6.11σ against the null and −0.61σ from the K law; beside it, free Cepheids give 4.38σ, below 5. It is a retrodiction without fit, with an amendment made after the guard, and the test is not blind. It is read with the whole record: of the 11 pre-registered charges of the ledger none was falsified, and the earlier test of the same law stayed below the step and is not independent of this one. Proved is validity, not creditation: creditation belongs to the observer who rereads, and more sensitive data could revise. In the other channels nothing discriminates GR at the available sensitivity.
